grid.note: cell id = gy * nx + gx, gy counted south from origin_n

provenance.headline: RECONSTRUCTION — not the official ARVC dataset.
provenance.method: Each published ARVC map figure was georeferenced from its own printed SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 22S graticule (max residual ~16 m, verified against the official municipal boundary), the printed colours were matched back to the 10-step ColorBrewer Reds legend, and the per-pixel values were averaged to this 250 m grid. Values carry classification error and must not be cited as WayCarbon/ICLEI output.
provenance.source_document: P3 — Análise de Riscos e Vulnerabilidade Climáticas, Plano de Ação Climática de Porto Alegre (2023)
provenance.source_authors: WayCarbon, ICLEI, Ludovino Lopes Advogados, Ecofinance
provenance.coverage_note: The ARVC masks water, parks and áreas verdes out of its own index. A cell with no value was masked at source — it is NOT low risk.
